messages:
eloise_research: Heads-up: onboarding run for atlas64k-int3 with stride-bucket-v2 prefill produced subtle token-shift artifacts after ~18k tokens. Repro steps and small logs below.
frank_infra: Can you drop the exact serve flags and the image tag?
eloise_research: serve cmd: `./serve --model atlas64k-int3 --prefill-policy stride-bucket-v2 --kv-mode sparse --quant=int3_chunked --compress-meta=false --prefill-window 24576` image: gh/regressions/atlas-int3:pr-4228
harry_eval: What do you mean by "token-shift artifacts"? sample output?
eloise_research: short sample (gold vs int3):
```
GOLD: "The committee concluded the report with unanimous support for the proposal."
INT3: "The committee concluded report with a unanimous support the proposal."
```
eloise_research: note drop/duplication pattern around long proper-noun spans and dates. perplexity on goldset: fp16=8.9, int3=12.7 (5-item anchor set).
frank_infra: Run `kv-dump --keys 0..5 --format=hex --after-prefill` on both runs and paste first/last entries. Also run `rope-phase-delta --compare fp16 int3 --seed 42 --span 20480`.
gina_prodeng: if kv-dump differs but checksums match, watch for index-stable-sort assumptions in sparse path. We had similar in 2023 with sparse tiling.
eloise_research: pasted kv-dump excerpt:
```
fp16 kv[0]=a1b2c3d4... kv[5]=d4c3b2a1...
int3 kv[0]=a1b2c3d4... kv[5]=d4c3b2a1...
int3(sparse-compact) kv[0]=a1b2c3d4... kv[5]=d4b3c2a1... <-- mismatch at index 5
```
harry_eval: rope-phase-delta output: max phase shift ~0.0031 rad at pos 18432, cumulative drift aligns with drift onset in outputs.
frank_infra: Good signal. Two hypotheses: (1) sparse-compact reorders entries when bucket stride != 1 leading to misaligned position multipliers; (2) int3 chunked quant tables applied per-shard with stale scale offsets.
gina_prodeng: Quick mitigation: flip `--prefill-policy=stride-bucket-v1` and disable sparse compacting for canary. Can someone open an emergency canary revert if the canary fails the goldset? :warning:
eloise_research: I'll run v1 + a deterministic prefill (seeded) and post rope diffs + goldset numbers. Also starting a bisect between commits 0f3a2..b4c9e to find where sparse-compact behaviour changed.
frank_infra: If bisect points to compacting code, please include a small kernel-level unit test for index stability and push with the revert.
deploy-bot: image gh/regressions/atlas-int3:pr-4228 deployed to canary cluster c-4 at 2026-03-23T15:12:10Z :rocket:
eloise_research: thanks — kicking off v1 run now, will follow up with concrete diffs + proposed PR title (e.g., "fix: sparse compact bucket offset for stride-bucket-v2").
